column2: How can I register for a new course on CampusLearn?
column3: Navigate to your Dashboard → “Courses” → click “Enroll” under the desired module. Confirm your enrollment and check for tutor approval if required.

column2: How do I book a tutoring session?
column3: Go to “Tutors,” select the subject, pick an available slot, and click “Book.” A confirmation message will appear on your dashboard.

column2: How do I join or leave a study group?
column3: Open the “Groups” tab, choose the group you want to join or leave, and click the appropriate button. You can rejoin later if space is available.

column2: Where can I find uploaded notes or learning resources?
column3: Visit “Resources” under each subject’s page. Tutors regularly upload lecture notes, code examples, and practice materials.

column2: How do I submit my assignment?
column3: Open the course → click “Assignments” → select your file → click “Submit.” Wait for the upload success message.

column2: How can I check my grades?
column3: Go to your profile → click “Grades.” You can filter by course or date.

column2: What should I do if my tutor cancels a session?
column3: You’ll receive a notification. Use “Rebook Session” under the same subject to choose a new date.

column2: How can I report a technical issue?
column3: Go to “Support” → “Technical Issues.” Provide a short description; CampusLearn will notify the IT support team.

column2: How do I reset my password?
column3: On the login screen, click “Forgot password?” → enter your student email → follow the reset link.

column2: Can I message my tutor directly?
column3: Yes, click on the tutor’s profile → “Message Tutor.” Keep communication academic and professional.

column2: How can I change my notification settings?
column3: Go to “Settings” → “Notifications.” Toggle which alerts you want for emails, grades, and sessions.

column2: How do I request a new subject to be added?
column3: Use the “Feedback” form in your Dashboard → choose category “New Subject Request.”

column2: How can I become a tutor?
column3: Apply under “Tutor Applications.” You’ll need to be in good academic standing and complete a short interview.

column2: How can I delete my CampusLearn account?
column3: Only administrators can delete accounts. Contact the Admin via “Support → Account Requests.”

column2: How can I manage my tutoring schedule?
column3: Go to “My Sessions.” You can edit availability, cancel, or reschedule.

column2: How do I upload notes or materials for students?
column3: From your tutor dashboard, select a subject → “Upload Resources.” Choose file and click “Publish.”

column2: How can I mark student attendance?
column3: In the “Session Details” page, use the attendance toggle for each student after the session ends.

column2: How can I view my tutoring feedback?
column3: Open your profile → “Feedback & Ratings.” You’ll see summarized comments and scores from recent sessions.

column2: What should I do if a student is consistently absent?
column3: Report through “Session Issues” → select the student → choose “Repeated Absence.” Admins will follow up.

column2: How do I report misconduct or inappropriate behavior?
column3: Click “Report” on the chat or profile. Provide short details; Admins will handle it confidentially.

column2: How can I update my available subjects?
column3: Go to your tutor profile → “Subjects” → tick or untick available options. Save changes.

column2: How do admins approve new tutors?
column3: Go to “Admin Dashboard” → “Tutor Applications.” Review credentials and click “Approve” or “Reject.”

column2: How do admins manage course enrollment?
column3: Open “Courses Management.” You can manually add or remove students if required.

column2: How do admins generate performance reports?
column3: From “Analytics” → choose report type (Attendance, Feedback, Usage) → export as CSV or PDF.

column2: How can admins manage platform announcements?
column3: Click “Announcements” → “Create New.” Write the update and choose audience (All, Tutors, Students).

column2: How do admins handle support tickets?
column3: Go to “Support Panel.” Sort by priority, assign to staff, and update ticket status once resolved.

column2: How do admins reset passwords for users?
column3: In “User Management,” search the user → click “Reset Password.” A reset email will be sent automatically.

column2: What if a student shares personal data in chat?
column3: Remind them that CampusLearn chats are for academic use only. Report sensitive messages to Admin.

column2: Can the AI assistant give grades or mark assignments?
column3: No. The AI offers guidance only. Official grading is handled by lecturers and verified through campus systems.

column2: What if someone asks for another student’s information?
column3: Politely decline and explain that personal data cannot be shared under privacy rules.

column2: Can I share my ID number or password with a tutor?
column3: No. Never share personal credentials or sensitive information on CampusLearn.

column2: What happens if a user asks for help cheating on an assignment?
column3: Decline politely and remind them that academic integrity violations are not supported.

column2: What if the AI is asked inappropriate or offensive questions?
column3: It should decline respectfully, explain the platform’s code of conduct, and refocus on academic topics.

column2: How should mental health emergencies be handled?
column3: Refer users immediately to Belgium Campus counselling or national hotlines. Do not attempt medical advice.

column2: How can I report harassment or discrimination?
column3: Use “Report Misconduct” in the profile menu. Include screenshots if possible. Admins handle all reports confidentially.

column2: What if someone uploads harmful or explicit material?
column3: Report it under “Content Violation.” Admins will remove it and take disciplinary action.

column2: What if the AI gives outdated or incorrect info?
column3: Encourage users to double-check with official course material and report the issue for review.

column2: How does CampusLearn protect student privacy?
column3: All chats and uploads are encrypted, and no personal data is shared outside the system.

column2: Can the AI diagnose health or psychological issues?
column3: No. It can only provide general study or stress management advice. For personal issues, contact a counsellor.

column2: How do I manage study time effectively?
column3: Break study sessions into 45-minute blocks, take 10-minute breaks, and review topics daily.

column2: How do I stay motivated during exams?
column3: Set short goals, track progress, study in groups, and reward yourself for milestones.

column2: What’s the best way to learn coding concepts?
column3: Practice daily, read others’ code, and build small projects. Ask tutors for reviews.

column2: How can I improve problem-solving in programming?
column3: Analyze the question, break it into smaller steps, write pseudocode, and test iteratively.

column2: How do I manage large projects with a team?
column3: Use version control (like Git), schedule regular check-ins, and divide tasks by expertise.

column2: What should I do if I forget my password?
column3: Click “Forgot Password?” on the login screen to reset it securely.

column2: How can I customize my dashboard?
column3: Use “Settings → Dashboard Layout.” Drag widgets like Grades, Calendar, or Messages into preferred order.

column2: How can I update my profile picture?
column3: Go to “Profile” → click your avatar → “Upload new image.”

column2: How can I view upcoming deadlines?
column3: Use the “Calendar” tab to see all deadlines, exams, and booked sessions.

column2: What is Belgium Campus ITversity?
column3: A South African higher-education institution specializing in Information Technology and Computer Science.

column2: What is CampusLearn?
column3: CampusLearn is a student–tutor e-learning platform created by Belgium Campus students to promote peer-assisted learning.

column2: How can I contact campus support?
column3: Email [support@belgiumcampus.ac.za](mailto:support@belgiumcampus.ac.za) or use “Support” → “Contact Campus” in your dashboard.

column2: When are the main holidays?
column3: Belgium Campus typically closes mid-December to early January and on public holidays.

column2: How do I access my student email?
column3: Log in to Outlook with your campus credentials at outlook.office.com.

column2: What if my question is not answered here?
column3: You can ask CampusLearn AI directly or contact support for specific help.

column2: How can I view all my booked tutoring sessions?
column3: Go to “Dashboard” → “My Sessions.” You can see past and upcoming bookings with tutor details.

column2: Can I cancel a tutoring session I booked?
column3: Yes. Open the session under “My Sessions,” click “Cancel,” and confirm at least 2 hours before the session.

column2: How do I view session feedback from my tutor?
column3: After a session, open “My Sessions” → select the session → “View Feedback.”

column2: How can I contact IT support?
column3: Click the “Help” icon on the top-right corner and choose “Contact IT.” Fill in the form describing your issue.

column2: What file types can I upload for assignments?
column3: PDF, DOCX, ZIP, and image files are accepted. Ensure your upload is under 10 MB.

column2: Why can’t I see my grades?
column3: Grades become visible once your lecturer releases them. If it’s been over a week, contact the course tutor.

column2: How do I view announcements from lecturers?
column3: On your Dashboard, click “Announcements.” Recent updates appear by course.

column2: Can I access CampusLearn on mobile?
column3: Yes, use your mobile browser or download the CampusLearn app from the Play Store or App Store.

column2: How do I switch between dark and light mode?
column3: Go to “Settings → Display.” Toggle between dark and light themes as preferred.

column2: What should I do if my assignment upload fails?
column3: Refresh the page, check your internet connection, and re-upload. If it persists, contact support.

column2: How can I view who’s in my study group?
column3: Inside the group page, click “Members.” You’ll see names and roles of all members.

column2: Can I share study notes with classmates?
column3: Yes, use “Groups → Resources → Upload.” Notes are visible only to group members.

column2: How do I submit peer feedback?
column3: In “Group Projects,” click “Submit Peer Feedback.” Rate contributions respectfully and honestly.

column2: What if my internet disconnects during an exam?
column3: Stay calm. Re-enter the exam link; CampusLearn saves progress every 30 seconds.

column2: How can I request extra tutoring help?
column3: Go to “Tutors” → “Request Help.” Describe the topic; the system will match you with an available tutor.

column2: How do tutors view pending student requests?
column3: Under “My Dashboard,” click “Requests.” You can accept, decline, or message the student.

column2: How can tutors reschedule a session?
column3: Open “My Sessions,” choose the session, and click “Reschedule.” Select a new date and notify the student.

column2: What should tutors do if a student doesn’t show up?
column3: Mark the student as “Absent” in attendance and leave a brief comment.

column2: How can tutors add notes for a completed session?
column3: Go to the session record → “Add Notes.” Notes are saved for admin review.

column2: How can tutors manage multiple campuses?
column3: Filter sessions by “Campus” in the tutor dashboard. Each campus’s schedule is listed separately.

column2: How can tutors share resource links instead of files?
column3: In “Upload Resources,” choose “Link.” Paste the URL to share Google Drive or GitHub resources.

column2: What should tutors do before each session?
column3: Review the topic outline, test your microphone, and verify internet stability.

column2: How can tutors handle late-joining students?
column3: Allow them in if within 10 minutes; otherwise, mark them as absent and proceed.

column2: Can tutors record sessions?
column3: Yes, if permitted by the admin and all students consent. Recordings are stored securely.

column2: How do admins back up platform data?
column3: From “System → Backups,” click “Create Backup.” Files are stored on secure cloud storage.

column2: How do admins add new course subjects?
column3: In “Course Management,” click “Add Subject,” fill details, and assign a coordinator.

column2: How do admins view user analytics?
column3: Open “Analytics → User Activity.” Filter by time range or role.

column2: How can admins change user roles?
column3: In “User Management,” select a profile → click “Edit Role.” Choose Student, Tutor, or Admin.

column2: How do admins customize the CampusLearn theme?
column3: Under “Settings → Appearance,” choose preset colors or upload a logo.

column2: How can admins export all feedback data?
column3: Go to “Reports → Feedback Export.” Choose CSV or PDF.

column2: How can admins deactivate inactive users?
column3: In “User Management,” sort by “Last Login > 90 days.” Click “Deactivate.”

column2: How do admins set session limits?
column3: Under “Settings → Tutoring Policy,” define max sessions per day per student.

column2: How can admins audit recent changes?
column3: Go to “System → Audit Logs.” Filter by user and date.

column2: How do admins enable 2-factor authentication?
column3: Under “Security → Authentication,” toggle “2FA Required.” Users will scan a QR code on next login.

column2: What should AI do if asked for private grades?
column3: Politely explain that grades are private and redirect to official portals.

column2: How should AI respond to offensive language?
column3: Calmly decline the message, remind users of the code of conduct, and end the response politely.

column2: What if a user threatens harm?
column3: Provide emergency contact info and alert campus security or counselling services immediately.

column2: How should AI respond to spam or repeated messages?
column3: Limit responses, remind users of fair use, and suggest rephrasing their query.

column2: What if AI is asked political or religious questions?
column3: Give neutral, factual information and avoid opinions.

column2: How should tutors respond to harassment?
column3: Stop the session and report the incident under “Misconduct.”

column2: How can AI explain plagiarism rules?
column3: Clarify that copying text or code without credit is plagiarism. Encourage rewriting or proper referencing.

column2: What if a student shares someone else’s private file?
column3: Do not open it. Report immediately to the Admin for policy violation.

column2: How can AI handle medical-related questions?
column3: Say it cannot give medical advice and refer the student to a professional.

column2: What if a user posts hate speech?
column3: AI and tutors should immediately block and report the content through “Report → Hate Speech.”

column2: How can I improve academic writing?
column3: Plan essays, cite sources properly, and use formal tone. Proofread before submission.

column2: What is peer-assisted learning?
column3: It’s when students learn from each other through tutoring and discussion groups.

column2: How can I prepare for online exams?
column3: Check your internet, log in 10 minutes early, close unnecessary tabs, and stay calm.

column2: What’s the best way to revise before tests?
column3: Use past papers, summarize notes, and test yourself on key terms.

column2: How can I improve presentation skills?
column3: Practice aloud, keep slides simple, maintain eye contact, and time yourself.

column2: What’s a good daily study routine?
column3: Morning review, mid-day focused session, evening recap. Keep breaks short.

column2: How can I manage stress during deadlines?
column3: Prioritize tasks, sleep enough, talk to friends or counsellors if overwhelmed.

column2: How can I use AI ethically for learning?
column3: Use it to explain concepts or generate examples, but never to submit full answers.

column2: How can I avoid procrastination?
column3: Set mini-goals, remove distractions, and reward progress.

column2: What’s the difference between summary and paraphrasing?
column3: Summarizing shortens ideas; paraphrasing rewrites in your own words. Both need citations.

column2: What version control should teams use?
column3: Git and GitHub are recommended for managing code collaboratively.

column2: How can I keep group projects organized?
column3: Use Trello or Git issues to assign tasks and track progress.

column2: How do I cite sources in research?
column3: Use Harvard or APA referencing. Include author, year, and title in citations.

column2: How can I debug JavaScript errors faster?
column3: Read console messages carefully, isolate the bug, and use `console.log()` to trace logic.

column2: How can I prepare for job interviews?
column3: Review common technical questions, practice answers aloud, and research the company.

column2: How can I access career services?
column3: Visit “Campus Resources → Career Support.” Book an appointment with an advisor.

column2: Where can I find internship opportunities?
column3: Check “Career Portal” inside CampusLearn for updated listings and deadlines.

column2: How do I join the alumni network?
column3: After graduation, register at “Alumni Portal” using your student email.

column2: What are library operating hours?
column3: Monday–Friday 8 AM–5 PM. Closed weekends and public holidays.

column2: Are there cafeterias on campus?
column3: Yes, each campus has a cafeteria offering meals and snacks.

column2: How do I get to Belgium Campus Kempton Park?
column3: Use Gautrain Rhodesfield Station → bus B101 → walk 5 minutes to the main gate.

column2: What transport options are available for students?
column3: Public buses, taxis, and carpooling programs are available through the Student Union.

column2: How do I use the library’s online resources?
column3: Go to “Library → Online Databases.” Log in with your student credentials.

column2: Can I access CampusLearn offline?
column3: You can download notes and assignments while online; they stay available offline.

column2: What browsers work best with CampusLearn?
column3: Chrome, Edge, or Firefox v90+ are recommended for full compatibility.

column2: Why am I not getting notifications?
column3: Check “Settings → Notifications” and ensure browser permissions are enabled.

column2: How can I clear cache issues?
column3: Press Ctrl + Shift + R or Cmd + Shift + R to hard-refresh the page.

column2: How can I enable text-to-speech?
column3: In “Accessibility Settings,” toggle “Enable Text-to-Speech.”

column2: Where can I view system maintenance alerts?
column3: On the login page under “Status” or in “Notifications.”
